blindness: Neither lane of a packet was given the other lane's output or the repository catalogs; each packet excluded seathatflowsinourveins/native-agent-stack, seathatflowsinourveins/agent-ecosystem, their catalogs and any other lane's output.

Codex model-screen lane: its stream shows one read of the packet, no query or page open naming the excluded repositories, and three computer-use browser calls that loaded no page. It finished (23:53) before the Claude return existed (00:12).

Codex memory-system lane: its stream shows a filtered listing of its working directory, a read of the packet, and a read of the ecosystem-catalog skill's SKILL.md, which belongs to the excluded agent-ecosystem repository's tooling; no catalog query or catalog data read follows, and no web query or open names the excluded repositories. It finished (00:28) before the Claude return existed (00:47).
Claude lanes: their tool logs were not retained, so their blindness rests on the packet instruction. Each ran while the same packet's Codex return existed in the lanes directory.

Judges: the Claude return's header comment was removed and lane identities appear only in the key. The q1 shared context names Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra as the client models the memory must serve; that is subject matter, not authorship. Each judge stream shows a single command, a read of its own brief, and no web search.
not_copied: The Codex lanes' JSONL event streams and stderr, and the nine judge event streams and stderr files: raw streams hold thread identifiers and local paths. Counts, commands (with the local skills path generalized), page opens and usage are extracted into the lane returns, the adjudication records and usage.json.
The convergence workflow's structured result and the CLAUDE.md manifest (see not_embedded_inputs).
pin_resolution: The recorder resolved the convergence table's short revisions and release tags to full commits on 2026-09-25 through the GitHub GraphQL API (tags and commits) and the Hugging Face model API (main revisions, licence tags, gating). Every Hugging Face short revision in the table is its repository's current main revision. Nothing was downloaded or installed.
